svg.text: K6b PRESS — a swinging column at the bench corner, a tube on its own legs
The column parks low at the front edge, below the gantry's path; the first 25 mm of its stroke swing the arm over the tube.
3 kN pull-down · stroke 250 mm · arm 200 mm
servo screw under zone A; scraper + drained lantern seal
tube Ø 110 on three legs over the receiving vessel
plates: open, grid 6, grid 10, ricer 3, Spätzle 8, wedger, former 55
Top view: the helical cam swings the arm
Parked: arm along the front edge, low, out of the
gantry's way. Going down, a helical cam turns the
arm over the tube in the first 25 mm, then it pulls.
parked low: top below the gantry's lowest arm path
The piston advances 6 mm, the slide (stroked by the
chuck) cuts a 6 mm layer off below the grid.
Boiled potato halves go in with the skin; 1–2 kN
presses the flesh through 3 mm, skins stay in the tube.
Frikadellen: former Ø 55 + cut-off slide, then jiggled round
Mass is pushed 46 mm through the Ø 55 former, the slide cuts a 110 g plug onto a wetted tray (±5 % on the load pins);
the gantry shakes the tray in X at 3 Hz for 20 s, the plugs roll round; the presser later smashes each to 22 mm.

g.text: 1/3 Swing: the column rises from its low park; the helical cam turns the arm over the tube in the first 25 mm
2/3 Work: dice 6 mm per slide stroke · rice potatoes with their skins · form 110 g plugs with the former
3/3 Park: the column goes down and swings back to the front edge, below the gantry's path; the tube goes to the well
